fusions.name: Toy With It
fusions.desc: Catches the target with a claw and bats it away, dealing 13 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Done Playing
fusions.desc: A killing strike with claws set, dealing 20 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Dangled Lure
fusions.desc: Dangles a baited line 3 tiles long for 5 seconds. It drags nearby enemies toward it.

fusions.name: Mouser on the Prowl
fusions.desc: A bonded mouser prowls with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Its curved claws leave them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
